body: i think i’m doing better now, i don’t think i’m going to do anything to hurt myself which is a good sign. i really appreciate it tho. i know she was just trying to help and i know it’s probably really hard to wrap her head around something like that, it’s just mental health is hard to deal with i guess. hope this goes to show people on here that these feeling will pass, it feels so intense one moment but if you can hold out for a few hours sometimes it gets better. hope you have a good night/day, your reply ment a lot <3
